name: yak
description: The kernel Worker's npm dependencies, bundled by wrangler; node_modules is gitignored, so `npm ci` here before `wrangler deploy` or a probe boot. Exact pins only. This directory is a Deno workspace member (root deno.json `workspace`), which is what keeps deno's config discovery walking past this file to the repo's one deno.json instead of stopping here.
